user.title: Commute Tracker Setup
user.description: Configure your commute tracking options and household timing defaults.

overview.name: Commute Overview
overview.description: Set the commuter person, friendly commute name, and tracking activation sensor.

destination_timings.name: Destination & Timings
destination_timings.description: Configure your destination label, target arrival time, and preparation buffer.

rollup_strategy_sec.name: Rollup & Strategy
rollup_strategy_sec.description: Choose how the best route option is selected and configure buffer thresholds.

data_description.person: Home Assistant Person entity. Commuter name and picture are resolved dynamically from this person.
data_description.name: Friendly name for this commute (e.g. Work Morning).
data_description.active_sensor: Binary sensor or switch that activates tracking; avoids API polling when idle.
data_description.destination: Name or label of the final destination (e.g. Office).
data_description.target_destination_time: Desired arrival time at your final destination.
data_description.prep_seconds: Preparation time before leaving the house. Offsets notifications and urgency stages.
data_description.rollup_strategy: Strategy used to choose the optimal route.
data_description.route_late_buffer_seconds: Time margin to allow for a fallback route to be viable when using the Late with Buffer strategy.
data_description.poll_interval: Seconds between live transit feed refreshes while active.
data_description.staging_mode: Enable staging mode to run with simulated or testing data.

routes.title: Commute Routes

data_description.route_action: Choose whether to add a new route, edit an existing route, or finish configuration.

route.title: Route Configuration
route.description:
Configure transit details, walking durations, and buffers for this route option.

{stop_guidance}

service_details.name: Service Details
service_details.description: Transit provider, mode, line, and optional API credentials.

boarding_walk.name: Boarding & Walk
boarding_walk.description: Boarding stop and walk time from home.

alighting_walk.name: Alighting & Destination Walk
alighting_walk.description: Alighting station and walk duration to your destination.

data.name: Route Display Name
data.alighting_walk_seconds: Walk from Alighting Stop to Destination (seconds)

data_description.provider: Transit authority or data feed for this route.
data_description.line: Line name or route number (e.g. 73, victoria).
data_description.name: Display label for this option (e.g. Bus 73 or Victoria Line).
data_description.route_color: Hex colour code for badges and timelines (e.g. #DC241F).
data_description.boarding_stop: Station name or stop identifier code where you board.
data_description.boarding_walk_seconds: Comfortable walk time in seconds from home to the boarding stop.
data_description.grace_seconds: Maximum time in seconds you can shave off the walk by rushing.
data_description.alighting_stop: Station name or stop identifier code where you disembark.
data_description.alighting_walk_seconds: Walk time in seconds from the alighting stop to your final destination.

corridor.title: Corridor Tracking Stops
corridor.description: Select which upstream stops along the line branch to track approaching vehicles towards your boarding stop.

data_description.corridor_stops: Ordered upstream stops used to track approaching vehicles.
data_description.extra_stops: Optional comma-separated list of additional stop identifiers to monitor.

corridor_names.title: Corridor Stop Display Names
corridor_names.description: Customise display labels for each selected corridor stop. Short names will be shown on dashboard cards and status timelines.

stop_display_names.name: Stop Short Names
stop_display_names.description: Set user-friendly short names for corridor stations.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to transit provider.
error.invalid_name: Please enter a valid commute name.
error.invalid_sensor: Please select a valid entity for the active commute sensor.
error.invalid_line: Line identifier not recognised by provider.
error.invalid_boarding_stop: Boarding stop not found along this line.
error.invalid_alighting_stop: Alighting stop not found along this line.
error.mutual_grace: Cannot specify both grace_seconds and grace_fraction.
error.no_routes: At least one route must be configured.
error.no_commutes: At least one commute must be configured.
error.already_configured: A commute with this name is already configured.

abort.no_routes: At least one route must be configured.
